# Client scope document — verbatim transcription

**Source:** `Website_Features_Functional_Requirements.pdf` (client-supplied, 3 pages)
**Transcribed:** 5 August 2026
**Status:** This is the client's approved v1.0 scope. Do not edit this file — it is a record of what was received.

Amendments live in [`01-context.md`](01-context.md) §10 (scope delta v1.1). Where this document and the context doc disagree, this document is what the client has actually signed off on.

> This document outlines the proposed features and functionalities for the website. Its purpose is to finalize the project scope before design and development begin. The client is requested to review the listed features and provide approval or feedback.

---

## 1. Website Pages

| Sr. No. | Page | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Home | Main landing page with company overview and key sections |
| 2 | About Us | Company profile, mission, vision, and infrastructure |
| 3 | Services | Listing of all sterilization services |
| 4 | Service Details | Individual page for each service |
| 5 | Product Development Consultation | Consultation details with inquiry form |
| 6 | Blog | Blog listing and article pages |
| 7 | FAQ | Frequently asked questions |
| 8 | Contact Us | Contact information, inquiry form, and location map |
